player_prompt.intro:
Wee mwini {player_id} mu Nimi.
Lengo lako ni kuchukula chinthu chilichose.
Pa kila mchenga, chagua tawe moja hasa na uchotseni moja au zaidi za zinthu.
Tumia fomu '[pile quantity]', ambapo tawe ndiyo nambari ya tawe na kiasi ndicho idadi ya zinthu zinazochotswa.
Kwa mfano, '[0 3]' inachotsa zinthu 3 kuchoka tawe 0.

invalid_move.wrong_format: Palibe mtundu wa kusuntha womwe wapezeka. Gwiritsani ntchito '[pile quantity]'.
invalid_move.correct_format_wrong_fields: Mwini {player_id}, Galu lilose. Kolombe {col} likuoneka kunja.

observation.removed_from_piles: Player {player_id} played [{pile_index} {quantity}], removing {quantity} object(s) from pile {pile_index}.
